title: Helps kids to learn/talk more..
text:
Update: My son is obsessed with shimajiro and anything tiger related now, that I had to subscribe back again. I am still yet to get response on my questions but I feel this box has helped the kid to communicate more .. thanks for that..

I saw a few good reviews, ordered & rxed the first set , gave 5 stars and went well.. In parallel , asked a valid question of same box -lesser price on amazon. Now I could not find any customer reviews, the boxes i saw in amazon and my question was not posted even unable to find in my history.. I am planning to cancel the subscription unless I get a valid answer to review back. Thanks Team !!
label: positive
